wholePhysicalScope: The cross-shaped model follows the 38 m east–west and 24.3 m north–south dimensions. The original sits on the site of mapped way 144655698, which contains the surviving instrument piers.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the original cross plan and four cylindrical observatory cupolas.
limitations: Historical appearance uses the completed early layout photographed around the close of 1898. The story opens in 1871 while the west tower was still being finished.
Original footprint is centered on the mapped successor site. Exact foundations outside the preserved instrument location, original paint colors and small roof hardware are approximate.
Historic grounds and nearby directors’ and assistants’ houses are outside the model scope.
